page.overview:
What is Ballon Terminal?

Ballon Terminal is a ruined city located on a Sky Island above the New World.

The sky island is suspended by a multitude of helium balloons along its underside. It is 10,000 meters directly above the Kid Pirates' former base.

Ballon Terminal is the location where all lost helium balloons end up, which keep it floating in the sky. At some point in time, a civilization moved to and thrived on Ballon Terminal, building multiple buildings. Eventually, this civilization ended for unknown reasons, and the buildings fell into ruins.

Urouge retreated here after sustaining wounds against the Big Mom Pirates. He and his Fallen Monk Pirates then encountered Kaidou, who attempted to commit suicide by jumping off the island as they watched.
